passages.text:
Ajoy Chawla (Ajoy), currently the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Company’s Jewellery Division, will succeed Venkat as the Managing Director with effect from 1st January 2026.
Ajoy Chawla graduated as a Mechanical Engineer from VJTI Mumbai and then did his PGDM from IIM-Calcutta. He became part of the Tata Administrative Services (TAS) in 1990 and initially joined the finance department of Titan in 1991. Over the next two decades, he was in the Watches Division, and played several roles spanning Commercial, Sales, Retailing, Supply chain, SAP implementation, leading accessories and licensed brands as SBU Head and then heading the Titan SBU for Domestic and International. Between 2013 and 2019, Ajoy was the Chief Strategy Officer of Titan, as well as heading Business Incubation, scaling the Fragrances business and establishing the Taneira business.
In October 2019, Ajoy became the CEO of Titan’s Jewellery Division. Under his leadership, the Jewellery Division has grown 2.5x in sales and profits and reinforced its market and thought leadership.
